entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference issue?

It's not broken... it's just so hard to use. The menu is really confusing and I just... I really expected more for the price. I feel a bit silly, but I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and this is the first time I've felt let down.

I understand completely. Sometimes a new device can have a bit of a learning curve. Did you have a chance to look at the quick-start section of the user manual? It often helps clarify the main functions.

I did. I read the user manual twice, but it didn't help. It just doesn't feel intuitive at all. Honestly, I saved up for this and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work for me. I just feel bad about the whole thing.
Please don't feel bad. We want you to be happy with your purchase. Let me just pull up your account and check the policy for you. Can I get the order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 28 days ago, on December 15th.
Is... is that too late? Oh, I hope it's not too late.
Not at all. I'm looking at our policy right now, and you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely get that returned for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. Thank you, Isaac. I was so worried.

Of course. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just place the band and all its accessories back in the original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll see the refund processed 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help today, thank you so much.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
